firma.csc_manca_url: Enter the remote signing service address
firma.csc_nota: Service compliant with the Cloud Signature Consortium (CSC) standard. The address, API user and password are provided by the certification authority when it enables access for external software. PIN and OTP are used only for this signature and are not saved.

firma.documento_da_controllare: Check that it is the right document
firma.in_corso_pin: Signing: if Windows asks for the PIN, enter it in its window

firma.manca_uscita: Choose where to save the signed file
firma.mostra_tutti: Also show certificates not qualified for signing
firma.nessun_certificato: No smart card, ID card or token found in Windows: insert it (with the certification authority's software or the CIE software installed) and press Refresh, or sign with your smartphone, with a remote signature or with a .p12/.pfx file.
firma.opz_telefono: With your smartphone (ID card with the CieSign app or the certification authority's app)...
firma.otp_inviato: OTP sent: check your SMS or the certification authority's app
firma.pdf_non_apribile: The signed PDF cannot be opened
firma.pin_windows: With a smart card, ID card or token, Windows asks for the PIN in its own window when signing: MB Visual never sees or stores it.
firma.riquadro_nota: Drag on the page to draw the signature box; a click moves it.
firma.riquadro_piccolo: Box too small: drag a larger area
firma.solo_pc: Digital signing is available in the PC app
firma.tel_intro: No reader needed: sign on your phone with the official CieSign app by holding the ID card near it (NFC), or with your certification authority's remote signing app (ArubaSign, GoSign, Namirial...). MB Visual checks the signed file as soon as it arrives.
firma.tel_manca_cartella: Choose the exchange folder (e.g. a OneDrive folder)
firma.tel_passo1: MB Visual copies the document to the exchange folder below (OneDrive).
firma.tel_passo2: On the phone, open the file from the OneDrive (or Files) app and share it with CieSign or your certification authority's app.
firma.tel_passo3: Sign it (with the ID card: PIN and card held against the phone).
firma.tel_passo4: Save the signed file to the same OneDrive folder: MB Visual finds it, checks it and saves it next to the original.
firma.tel_valore: With the Italian ID card the signature is an advanced electronic signature (AdES): valid for most documents, but not where the law requires a qualified signature (e.g. real estate deeds, tenders, Business Register).
firma.tipo_annidata_nota: Signs the whole envelope: a countersignature that includes the previous signatures.
firma.tipo_p7m_nota: The format required by public administrations, tenders and certified e-mail.
firma.tipo_p7m_pdf_nota: The PDF is wrapped in a .p7m file (opens with MB Visual, Dike, ArubaSign...).
firma.tipo_p7s_nota: The file stays as it is; the signature is in a file next to it with the same name + .p7s.
firma.tipo_pades_nota: The document stays a PDF that opens anywhere. More signatures can be added later.
firma.tipo_parallela_nota: The new signer is added to the same envelope, next to the existing ones.
firma.tsa_esempio: e.g. your certification authority's timestamp service
firma.tsa_nota: Qualified timestamps are sold by the certification authority with a user name and password. The password stays on the PC, encrypted by Windows.
firma.uscita_uguale: The signed file must have a different name from the original
firma.verifica_nota: Checked right after signing: document integrity and cryptographic signature. AgID/eIDAS trust chain and revocation not checked (they require the network).

stat.domanda_dett: If you agree, once a day MB Visual sends anonymous data: how often and how long you use the app, the types of files opened (only the extension, e.g. .pdf), the features used and errors. On the computer, counts not yet sent are kept for up to 40 days.
stat.inf_fini: To understand which formats and features are used most, which errors to fix first and which versions and systems to keep supporting. Data is only looked at in aggregate form and is not used to profile people or for advertising.
